correctness.rationale: With a=37/25+C/4, h=(a+1/8)/2 and q=(a+h/4)(1−h), one has 0<q<1/2<h<1 throughout the physical control range. The only zero of a q+q²/4−1/2 in [0,1] is the increasing quadratic factor's root C*. Independently, q decreases with q′≤−989/6400 and q≤212431/640000, so (a q+q²/4)′=q/4+(a+q/2)q′<0; the claimed root is obtained by taking 18h²−11h−3=0, for which q=h−1/2 and (a+q/4)q=1/2. The three distinct points give least period three. Each monotone branch expands by at least a and the endpoint images give A→B, B→I. Points below q but above zero grow by a factor at least a until they reach I; those above h but below 1 first go below q, while 1 goes to the fixed point 0. Thus there are no other periodic points outside the core. A cyclic allowed word has a unique fixed point of the composed inverse branches. For a periodic orbit hitting the shared endpoint c, the predecessor is q∈A, so c must be coded B, and the itinerary q,c,h has the allowed transitions A,B,B. All other periodic orbits have unambiguous itineraries; consequently the trace counts distinct points, plus one for 0. The determinant zeta identity and Perron root follow from the stated two-state matrix. Expansion gives the finite-to-one coding (after any first visit to c all subsequent endpoint visits have a forced code), and the primitive shift makes the core mixing. Outside I∪{0} each point has a wandering neighborhood: near a point of (0,q) its image lies strictly above that neighborhood and orbits cannot return from I; a neighborhood above h returns below h at once. Hence the full-interval entropy is the core entropy.
residual_risks: The all-period count and entropy are for ideal real arithmetic at the unique C*, not claims for a digitization, random-bit quality, or other controls.

value.rationale: Least critical period three is a natural nontrivial postcritical calibration in this published family, not an arbitrary numerical control value. The precise control and proven global distinct-point count give a benchmark for kneading and periodic-orbit computations on the nonlinear construction. The extra fixed point and the critical cell boundary matter to that benchmark and are not decided by quoting entropy or a symbolic trace alone. The contribution is modest and model-specific, not a new coding theorem.
residual_risks: No claimed practical performance or security measure follows from this idealized benchmark.
